::: {#leading}
We describe the main data objects of the MPX NYC study -- the
Person-place graph, the Person graph and the Place graph -- as well as
the statistics we used to analyze them. We assume data come from a Bipartite random network NPSEM-IE. We define statistic to describe causal mechanisms relating to mass action in networked space. We end with an outline of our approach to statistical inference and a description of the Bipartite random network NPSEM-IE bootstrap we conducted. 
:::
